      public static <A,B,C> List<A> mapFst(List<Triple<A,B,C>> triples)
      Returns the first element of the tuples in the same order. Equivalent to the Haskell code map fst.
      Type Parameters:
      A - the type of first element in the pairs
      B - the type of second element in the pairs

      Parameters:

      the first element of the tuples
